name: Nguru

queries.query: Nguru Yobe cadastral parcel map official land registry survey GIS
queries.result: First-party Yobe evidence identified Yobe Geographic Information Service (YOGIS) and Yobe State housing/property functions. The Yobe budget describes YOGIS GIS Phase II and house numbering, while the indexed YOGIS digitisation TOR describes land-record and parcel-survey-document workflows. No current public Nguru parcel viewer, schema, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry endpoint was found.
